title: Executive Assistant
description:

Location: Sheffield (Primarily Office-Based with up to 1 Day Hybrid Working)

Hours: Full Time (Flexibility Available for the Right Candidate)
Contract Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

We're delighted to be supporting our client in the search for an experienced and highly organised Executive Assistant to support the MD of a fantastic global company.

This is a rare opportunity to become a trusted partner to the company's MD, helping them maximise their impact by managing priorities, protecting their time, and ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day operations. Working at the heart of the business, you'll support senior leadership, complex diary management, international travel arrangements over different time zones,codordinate key projects and events, and play an important role in helping the organisation continue its impressive growth journey.

If you're a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys bringing structure and organisation to busy schedules, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide comprehensive executive support to the MD, managing priorities across multiple business areas.
- Proactively manage complex diaries, International travel plans,schedules, meetings, and appointments and monitor and triage inboxes, responding on behalf of the MD where appropriate.
- Monitor and triage inboxes, responding on behalf of senior leaders where appropriate.
- Arrange travel, accommodation, and detailed itineraries.
- Prepare meeting agendas, papers, briefing notes, and follow-up actions.
- Manage actions arising from meetings, ensuring tasks are followed through to completion.
- Coordinate leadership meetings, strategy sessions.
- Liaise confidently with clients, colleagues, and external stakeholders and handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion.
- Handle confidential and sensitive information with the highest level of professionalism and discretion.

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience as an Executive Assistant supporting senior leaders, directors, or business owners with experience supporting multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
- Exceptional organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, and modern workplace technology.
- Professional, diplomatic, and capable of dealing with confidential information.
- Experience handling complex diary management and international travel plans across many time zones.

What's In It For You?
- Competitive salary of £40,000 £50,000 FTE, depending on experience.
- Pension scheme
- Up to one day per week working from home.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Modern Sheffield office with parking options available.
- Comprehensive personal development.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

The Talent Division is committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams make stronger businesses and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

title: Sales Ledger Administrator
description:
Sewell Wallis is currently recruiting for a Sales Ledger Administrator to join the finance team of an established and growing business based in Penistone, South Yorkshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous transactional finance experience who enjoys working in a busy, varied and hands-on environment. The role will primarily focus on sales ledger administration, invoicing and credit control for a dedicated portfolio of repeat customers, alongside providing occasional holiday and absence cover for the weighbridge function.

The position is initially offered on a 12-month temporary contract, with a genuine opportunity for the role to become permanent for the right person.

What will you be doing?
- Managing the day-to-day administration of your own portfolio of repeat customers.
- Checking daily driver paperwork, round sheets and movement tickets against cash collected, ensuring all information is complete and accurate.
- Investigating discrepancies and missing information, liaising with drivers and operational colleagues to resolve queries.
- Preparing and raising weekly and monthly sales invoices.
- Monitoring cash collections and allocating customer receipts to the correct accounts.
- Supporting credit control activities, including issuing statements and investigating outstanding balances.
- Responding to customer account queries and providing copies of invoices and supporting documentation where required.
- Maintaining accurate customer account records and ensuring transactions are processed promptly.
- Providing holiday and absence cover for the weighbridge operation, typically around four weeks per year, with additional cover when required.
- Registering incoming and outgoing vehicles, processing driver paperwork and accurately entering information into the weighbridge system.

What skills are we looking for?
- Previous experience in sales ledger, accounts receivable, credit control, invoicing or a similar transactional finance administration role.
- Excellent attention to detail, with the ability to identify missing or inconsistent information.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage recurring daily, weekly and monthly tasks.
- Comfortable working with paperwork, cash records and computer-based systems.
- Good Microsoft Excel skills.
- Experience using Sage 200 would be advantageous.
- Confident communication skills, with the ability to liaise with drivers, colleagues and occasionally customers.
- A proactive approach to investigating queries and resolving issues.
- The ability to work accurately and efficiently in a busy environment.
- A flexible approach and willingness to provide support across different areas of the business.

Formal finance qualifications are not required; practical experience, accuracy and the right attitude are more important.

What's on offer?
- Salary of £28,000 £30,000 per annum.
- Initial 12-month temporary contract, with the potential to become permanent.
- Monday to Friday working hours, 8:30am 5:00pm.
- Paid half-hour lunch break.
- Company pension scheme.
- Access to an employee discounts app.
- Free on-site parking.
- Full training and ongoing support from an experienced finance team.
- A varied role offering exposure to both finance administration and weighbridge operations.
- The opportunity to join an established and growing business with long-term career potential.

Please note: Due to the rural location of the site and limited public transport links, you must hold a full driving licence and have access to your own vehicle. This is a fully office-based position, Monday to Friday.

For more information, contact Inci or apply below.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry. We offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. We are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: Sales Support Executive
description:
Job Title: Sales Support Executive

Location: Sheffield

Salary: c£35,000

The Client

Our client is an engineering-driven company specialising in magnetics. It serves high-technology applications in aerospace, defence, motorsport, medical and other industrial markets. Its work is technically demanding, low-volume and high-value, where quality, accuracy, communication and delivery matter.

They are looking to add a Sales Support Executive to their team.

The Role of Sales Support Executive

As Sales Support Executive, you will be the first point of contact for customer enquiries. You will keep quotations and orders moving smoothly through the business.

You will log and acknowledge enquiries, gather the technical and commercial details needed to quote, help prepare quotations, and follow them up. Once an order is won, you will help hand it over to Production and keep the customer updated through to delivery.

This is a busy, detail-focused role. It suits someone who likes being organised, is comfortable around engineering information, and wants to build customer relationships in a specialist technical environment.

What You Will Be Doing
- Responding to incoming customer enquiries by phone and email.
- Logging enquiries and gathering drawings, specifications, quantities, materials, tolerances and delivery requirements.
- Preparing quotations, or helping prepare them, accurately and on time.
- Following up quotations and keeping opportunities moving.
- Processing customer orders and supporting a smooth handover to Production.
- Liaising with Production and Engineering on lead times and delivery dates.
- Keeping customers updated on order progress.
- Keeping customer, quotation and order records accurate.
- Supporting the sales team with account management and repeat business.

What We Are Looking For

You will probably come from a sales support, sales administration, customer service, estimating or order processing background, ideally in engineering or manufacturing.

You do not need to know everything on day one. But you must be comfortable around engineering detail and willing to learn how our client prices, plans and delivers specialist work.

You will need to be able to:
- Stay organised and accurate with a high volume of enquiries and paperwork.
- Ask sensible questions to get the information a quote needs.
- Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, engineers and production teams.
- Follow up properly without being pushy.
- Stay calm when priorities change.
- Be honest when something needs checking.
- Use Microsoft Office and business systems confidently.

Business: The ReFood AD plants operate as integrated recycling units, processing a variety of food wastes to produce biogas, renewable electricity, heat and ReGrow (a nutrient-rich fertiliser for local farms). The plants also recycle the food waste packaging providing an environmentally sustainable solution for all waste producers looking for a safe method of diverting food waste from landfill.

The Position

Applications are invited for a Central Transport Purchasing Administrator based at our Doncaster site. This is a full time, permanent, position working 40 hours per week.

As a Central Transport Purchasing Administrator, your duties and responsibilities will vary on the Company s requirements but will include the following:
- Act as the central administrator for all transport purchase orders across the Doncaster, Widnes and Dagenham sites.
- Raise purchase quotes promptly using the information and supporting documentation provided by the relevant Transport Manager or requester.
- Ensure purchase order information is entered accurately, with particular attention to supplier details, dates, cost centres, values and other required system information.
- Monitor purchase quotes through the internal approval process and follow up with approvers where necessary to prevent avoidable delays.
- Convert approved purchase quotes into purchase orders and issue the completed purchase orders to suppliers.
- Monitor purchase orders through to completion, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records within the internal purchase order system.
- Obtain confirmation from the requester or relevant site contact that goods have been received or services completed before receipting the purchase order within the system for payment.
- Assist the Group Purchasing team and Finance with the investigation and resolution of transport-related purchase order queries, including obtaining missing information from the relevant site.
- Obtain the necessary supplier information, complete new vendor setup forms accurately and submit them to the central team for approval and processing.
- Liaise effectively with Transport Managers, site teams, Group Purchasing, Finance, internal approvers and approved suppliers in relation to purchase order administration.
- Undertake any other reasonable administrative duties as required, commensurate with the level of the role.

The Person
- Strong previous experience within an administrative role.
- Previous experience using a purchase order or purchasing system, including raising, monitoring or receipting purchase orders.
- Able to work independently whilst contributing positively to a wider team across multiple sites.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate data entry.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel, together with the ability to learn and confidently use the company's internal purchase order system.

Salary: Competitive Salary plus Company Benefits

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted due to the high volume of CV s being received.

title: Contact Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

description:
Bookkeeper (Part-Time or Full-Time)

Location: Rotherham, with hybrid working
Hours: Part-time (3 days per week) or full-time (5 days per week)
Salary: £22,000 to £25,000 per annum for part-time; up to £35,000 per annum for full-time

About the role

We're looking for a reliable, detail-focused Bookkeeper to join our team at our Rotherham office. You'll keep our finances accurate and up to date, with the flexibility of hybrid working. You can choose between a 3-day part-time week and a full-time 5-day week.

Key duties
- Process sales and purchase invoices, and allocate them correctly
- Manage the purchase ledger and supplier payments
- Raise sales invoices and chase outstanding payments
- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and control accounts
- Enter and reconcile daily transactions in the accounting system
- Process expenses and petty cash
- Prepare VAT returns and support payroll submissions
- Carry out month-end tasks, including journals, accruals and prepayments
- Produce basic management reports
- Keep records organised and audit-ready, and work with our accountants at year end

About you
- Previous bookkeeping or accounts experience
- Experience with accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks or Sage
- Good working knowledge of VAT and general bookkeeping principles
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills
- Confident with Excel and everyday office software
- A proactive, honest approach who can work independently and meet deadlines
- AAT or similar qualification is desirable but not essential

What we offer
- Hybrid working
- Your choice of part-time or full-time hours
- A friendly, supportive office in Rotherham
- Competitive salary based on experience and hours

To discuss this career opportunity in further detail, please contact Josh Wakefield on (phone number removed) / (url removed) - I look forward to hearing from you

Bookkeeper

Rotherham £28,000 £30,000 FTE Full-Time or Part-Time Flexible 3 5 Days

V-Recruit are working in partnership with an established construction contractor operating within the public sector, who are looking to bring their bookkeeping function in-house by recruiting an experienced Bookkeeper to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented finance professional to take ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping activities, supporting the smooth running of the company's financial operations.

The position is based in Rotherham, with flexibility to accommodate either full-time or part-time working arrangements, offering between 3 5 days per week.

The Role

Working closely with the wider team, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices received through Dext and checking extracted information for accuracy and completeness before publishing to QuickBooks.
- Ensuring all relevant invoice details, including class allocations, are correctly recorded.

- Allocating and coding additional bank transactions accurately.

- Previous experience in a similar Bookkeeper or Accounts role.
- Essential experience using QuickBooks.
- Experience using Dext would be advantageous.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger, bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Knowledge of VAT returns and CIS processes.
- Experience with payroll journals and cost allocations.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies.
- The ability to work independently, manage workloads and meet deadlines.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Our client is a well-established and successful manufacturer. They are looking for a Logistics Coordinator to co-ordinate new equipment projects for national and international shipping to customers.

Salary: £15.00 per hour + Overtime

NOTE: This is a temporary contract for 3 to 6 months (there may be a chance to go permanent, but not guaranteed)

PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU MEET THE MAJORITY OF THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS:
- A minimum of 3 years Logistics experience is essential, along with some experience in Supply Chain.
- You have experience of using a Counterbalance FLT, and have an in-date Counterbalance Forklift Truck license.
- You are fully conversant with Microsoft applications, particularly Dynamics 365, OneNote and Excel.
- Flexibility to work within a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
- Great communication skills, especially with teamwork.
- Time management, organisation, and prioritising skills.

Responsibilities:

The role will involve the aftermarket sales shipment handling with the Aftermarket Sales Co-Ordinator for preparation, documentation and transactional requirements in the system. The Logistics Co-ordinator role encompasses all elements of customer shipments including internal discussions, product expediting, supplier co-ordination for packing and loading, consumable management, all required documentation and organisation/communication with shipping agents. In parallel with general tasks, there is also a necessity to be involved with improvement projects for the Supply Chain team and Logistics functions.
- Facilitate the shipping of projects from one destination to another.
- Co-ordinating and taking part in the loading of shipments with fork lift truck drivers.
- Load preparation with Forklift Truck Drivers.
- Operate a Counterbalance Fork Lift Truck (with fork extensions).
- Orchestrate deliveries to meet customer demand to an internal on time in full delivery target.
- Liaising and management of packing and crating requirements, internal and external communication.
- Organising shipment collections.
- Internal communications for shipment of projects such as Production, Finance and any other department supporting the shipping process.
- Administrative requirements in the system including photographs and the use of Infor XA, OneNote and Microsoft applications (e.g. Excel and Dynamics 365).
- Creation and maintenance of project folders for Logistics information.
- Storage of projects prior to shipment and optimisation of space/capacity.
- Consumable management for Logistics requirements.
- New equipment identification tagging and checks.
- Creation of documents for use on project content checks and shipment inclusive of packing lists and commercial invoice.
- Take steps to avoid additional shipment of project content (i.e. missed items in the original shipment).
- Documenting shipment information such as photographs and paperwork per project.
- Volumetric analysis and expectations for shipment requirements i.e. container volume per project.
- Process reviews to streamline the shipping and transportation processes.
- Documentation and customer communication for Aftermarket sales orders.
- Shipment bookings for Aftermarket sales orders.
- Checks and compliance to the required country legislation for all documentation projects and Aftermarket sales orders.
- Purchase orders and transactions within Infor XA and AS400 in a timely manner for projects and Aftermarket sales orders.
- Any other task that is required to fulfil the duties within the Logistics and Supply Chain function.

This role would suit someone with experience in a similar role, such as; Logistics Planner / Dispatch Planner / Despatch Coordinator / Supply Chain Coordinator / Operations Coordinator / Transport Coordinator / Operations Scheduler / Logistics Specialist / Shipping Clerk / Export Coordinator / Shipping Coordinator / Fleet Coordinator / Logistics Supervisor / Logistics Manager / Export Coordinator

title: Facilities and Utilities Coordinator
company: DB Cargo UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Title: Facilities and Utilities Coordinator

Location: Doncaster (with occasional travel to sites across the UK)

Salary: 30,000 - 35,000 per year

Job Type: Full Time, Permanent.

Keeping the UK Freight Network Moving.

At DB Cargo UK, we play a vital role in keeping Britain's industries supplied and connected. From moving steel and aggregates to supporting major infrastructure projects, our people help deliver essential services across the country every day.

We're looking for a National Facilities & Utilities Co-ordinator to join our Facilities Management team. This is an opportunity to support the management of our nationwide property portfolio, helping ensure our depots, offices and operational locations remain safe, compliant, efficient and fit for purpose.

Reporting to the Head of Facilities Management, you'll play a key role in coordinating facilities services, statutory compliance activities, contractor management and utilities administration across the business. You'll also contribute to sustainability initiatives and support the delivery of an effective and resilient workplace environment.

What You'll Be Doing:

As National Facilities & Utilities Co-ordinator, you'll provide day-to-day support across a diverse property and operational estate. Your responsibilities will include:

Facilities Management & Maintenance:
- Coordinating planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance activities across multiple sites.
- Monitoring service delivery against agreed service levels and ensuring timely completion of works.
- Supporting depot and office teams with facilities-related queries and issue resolution.
- Maintaining accurate asset and maintenance records to support long-term planning.

Compliance & Safety:
- Supporting compliance with statutory requirements including fire safety, water hygiene, electrical testing and environmental regulations.
- Maintaining compliance documentation and records to support audits and inspections.
- Assisting with risk assessments, compliance reviews and corrective action tracking.

Contractor & Supplier Management:
- Acting as a key contact for facilities and utilities contractors.
- Ensuring contractors comply with DB Cargo UK's safety and site access requirements.
- Raising purchase orders, monitoring contractor performance and validating completed works.

Utilities Management:
- Coordinating utilities activities across the national property portfolio.
- Working with suppliers, tenants, stakeholders and energy partners to ensure efficient utilities administration.
- Supporting new connections, disconnections, meter installations and change-of-tenancy activities.
- Maintaining utilities consumption data and supporting budget forecasting and reporting.
- Assisting with sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

Property & Business Support:
- Supporting workspace planning and operational property requirements across depots and offices.
- Producing reports, dashboards and KPI updates for management review.
- Assisting with facilities budgets, service charge administration and expenditure tracking.
- Building effective relationships with operational, engineering and safety teams across the business.

What We're Looking For:

We're looking for an organised and proactive individual with facilities management experience and a strong customer-focused approach.

Essential:
- Experience within a facilities management support, property administration or facilities coordination role.
- Good understanding of maintenance management, contractor coordination and FM compliance requirements.
- Experience working with utilities processes, supplier relationships, meter data or energy administration.
- Strong organisational and prioritisation skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Competent user of Microsoft Office, CAFM systems and reporting tools.
- Willingness to travel occasionally to DB Cargo UK sites nationwide.

Desirable:
- IWFM Level 3 qualification or willingness to work towards one.
- Experience within rail, logistics, industrial or other safety-critical environments.
- Knowledge of utilities budgeting, asset management and sustainability initiatives.
- Understanding of CDM Regulations and project coordination.
- Awareness of IOSH or NEBOSH principles relevant to facilities operations.

What You'll Bring:

You'll be someone who:
- Takes ownership and works proactively to resolve issues.
- Has strong attention to detail and a commitment to high standards.
- Places safety at the centre of everything they do.
- Builds positive relationships with colleagues, suppliers and stakeholders.
- Works collaboratively while remaining confident in managing priorities independently.
- Adapts well in a fast-paced operational environment.

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

DB Cargo UK is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to providing an inclusive recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking to develop your career within facilities and utilities management while supporting one of the UK's leading rail freight operators, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help keep DB Cargo UK's property and infrastructure network operating safely, efficiently and sustainably.

Please click APPLY to send your CV for this role.

Candidates with experience of: Facilities Coordinator, Facilities Management Coordinator, Facilities Officer, Facilities Manager, Facilities Operations Coordinator, Facilities Support Officer, may also be considered for this role.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
A vacancy has arisen within the marketing department for a Training Coordinator to assist the Group Training Support Manager in the administration and delivery of the new starter inductions, and administration of other internal training requirements. The position will be based at Barnsley Head Office. You will join them on a full-time, permanent basis, and in return, you will receive a competitive salary.

As one of the UK s leading manufacturers of Kitchen, Bedroom and Bathroom fitted furniture, our client has had unsuppressed growth, with over 50 years experience. Their emphasis is on providing a high standard for all their products and the services they offer. They are currently seeking the very best people, to further strengthen their position within the industry by appointing dedicated individuals to share in their success.

The key responsibilities of their Training Coordinator:
- Deliver the Company Induction every Monday to all company new starters.
- Deliver all Temp-to-Perm inductions for transferred agency workers as required.
- Coordinate communications and ensure required processes are completed for all new starters.
- Coordinate all bookings, travel, and appointments for field-based new starters during their 12-week induction period.
- Keep all general induction materials and resources up to date.

company: Sheffield Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Sheffield Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a motivated and well-organised individual to join the Clerical Officer/Reception Team within the General Surgery service , Northern General Hospital. As a key member of the team, you will play an essential role in supporting our clinical colleagues and ensuring the smooth running of outpatient clinics and reception services. This varied and rewarding post involves providing high-quality clerical and administrative support to consultants, specialist nurses, patients, and visitors, helping us deliver the highest standard of care. You will be the first point of contact for patients and staff, managing appointments, preparing clinic documentation, maintaining accurate patient records, and ensuring clinics are fully supported and well-coordinated. The role requires strong communication skills, excellent organisation, and a caring, professional approach. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced clinical environment, values teamwork, and is looking to develop their skills within a supportive and friendly administrative team. To provide a friendly, welcoming, and efficient reception service for patients, visitors, and staff attending Outpatient clinics at the Northen General Hospital. To proactively monitor clinic status, including cancellations, reductions, and non-attendance, escalating issues where required to maintain safe and effective service delivery. To carry out general administrative duties, including managing correspondence, processing patient referrals and appointment requests. To ensure all patients are placed on the appropriate waiting or review lists so that no patients are lost to follow-up and all pathways are accurately maintained. To answer inbound call from patients and answer queries about the outpatient process. To contribute to the wider administrative team by providing cover for colleagues, supporting service improvements, and assisting in the induction of new staff.
